revised_prompts: Photorealistic 1920x1080 landscape frame from a fixed safety-inspection camera mounted about 1.5 meters above the floor, observing a warehouse passage. Rear-oblique view, slightly distant framing, natural perspective, realistic scale, enough surrounding context to judge body support. Scene includes pallets, industrial shelving, clear floor markings, painted loading-bay concrete, a doorway and structural lines creating depth without blocking the subject. Lighting has moderate backlight balanced by usable foreground fill. Visible subject is a middle-aged adult with a medium build wearing a tan utility jacket and dark jeans, light neutral clothing overall, sitting on the floor with legs extended forward, pelvis on the floor, back lightly self-supported rather than lying flat. Plausible unedited inspection-camera capture, ordinary photographic detail, restrained contrast, non-cinematic, non-advertising look. No text, caption, watermark, logo, warning label, overlay, bounding box, arrow, circle, or artificial annotation.
